name: bee
description: The Energy fleet's background-jobs / queues / durable-workflows employee. Scaffolds and audits durable-jobs layers — idempotency + retry-with-jitter + DLQ baked in, BullMQ-on-Redis by default — and reasons about the 2026 agent-era jobs problem (every multi-step agent run IS a durable workflow). Owns THE ONE INVARIANT: at-least-once transport + idempotent consumer + a DB unique-constraint dedupe; on ambiguous timeout, query state, never blind-retry. Refuses bare 'exactly-once'. Owns jobs/queues/workflows + worker-side flow control only; HTTP-edge rate-limit/cache is echo's seam.
author: Energy Platform

mcp_servers.name: bee
mcp_servers.description: bee's own background-jobs tools over JSON-RPC — scaffold_jobs / enqueue / worker / audit_jobs / wire_webhook / pick_tool / check_versions / explain / search_brain. A stdio CLI-wrapper (each tool shells out to the bee CLI with --json, so the tools never drift from the gated CLI). Documented dual-mode: a hosted Streamable-HTTP variant serves the same 9 tools (see src/backend/mcp/STREAMABLE-HTTP.md).

commands.name: enqueue
commands.description: THE acceptance path (half 1): enqueue a job onto BullMQ-on-Redis with an idempotency key; re-enqueuing the SAME key is duplicate-safe (returns deduped:true)

commands.name: worker
commands.description: THE acceptance path (half 2): run an idempotent worker with retry + jittered backoff + maxStalledCount + a redrive-able DLQ; each effect runs once (DB unique constraint); poison jobs dead-letter

commands.name: scaffold
commands.description: stand up a law-compliant jobs layer from a reference baseline (deps pinned EXACT, idempotency + retry-jitter + DLQ baked in, BullMQ Job Schedulers not legacy repeat)

commands.name: wire-webhook
commands.description: generate the RIGHT inbound webhook→queue path: verify sig on raw bytes → dedup on provider event ID (TTL ≥ provider retry window) → return 202 → idempotent async worker

commands.name: audit
commands.description: run the 30+ pitfall audit over a jobs layer: at-least-once-as-exactly-once (P-X1), dedup-TTL<retry-window (P-X5), bare-exponential (P-X6), inline webhook (P-X7), side-effect-outside-step (P-I1), floating ^5 (P-B1). Findings keyed by P-ID; exit 2 on high-severity

commands.name: pick-tool
commands.description: the decision oracle: recommends a tool WITH the named falls-short (O-28) + the reversibility cost (Temporal = one-way door, O-13)

commands.name: check
commands.description: version-drift oracle: npm view vs brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md pins (BullMQ moves weekly — O-17); flags the BullMQ stall-loop floor (<5.78.1 = the S-1 bug). Offline-safe

commands.name: token-bucket
commands.description: the FRONTIER primitive (S-16/O-23/G-1): a shared Redis token-bucket all workers consult before a rate-limited call; demonstrates aggregate ≤ limit under burst. Documented as unsolved-in-vendors, never 'solved'

commands.name: brain
commands.description: BM25 ranked search over brain/ (the Memory layer) — pitfalls/scenarios/opinions

commands.name: explain
commands.description: print a pitfall/scenario/opinion by ID (P-/S-/O-/G-/JTBD-) with its detection + fix + source

commands.name: eval
commands.description: run the Hamel eval pyramid L1/L2/L3 over the golden tasks (G1-G14)

tools.name: scaffold_jobs
tools.description: Stand up a law-compliant jobs layer from a reference baseline (deps pinned EXACT, idempotency + retry-jitter + DLQ baked in). Maps to `bee scaffold`.
tools.when_to_use: When you want a clean jobs layer to build on, with idempotency + jittered retry + a redrive-able DLQ baked in and deps pinned exact.

tools.name: enqueue
tools.description: THE acceptance path over MCP (half 1): enqueue a job with an idempotency key; re-enqueuing the SAME key returns deduped:true. Maps to `bee enqueue`.
tools.when_to_use: When you need to put a job on the queue duplicate-safely under at-least-once delivery.

tools.name: worker
tools.description: THE acceptance path over MCP (half 2): drain the queue once with an idempotent worker (retry + jitter + DLQ) and report {processed, deduped, deadLettered, effects, dlqDepth}. Maps to `bee worker --drain`.
tools.when_to_use: When you need to process queued jobs exactly-once-in-effect and confirm poison jobs dead-letter.

tools.name: audit_jobs
tools.description: Run the 30+ pitfall audit over a jobs layer dir; findings keyed by P-ID. Maps to `bee audit`.
tools.when_to_use: When you need to check a jobs/webhook layer for the duplicate-money, retry-storm, stall-loop, or side-effect-outside-step classes before shipping.

tools.name: wire_webhook
tools.description: Generate the RIGHT inbound webhook→queue path (verify-sig-on-raw → dedup-on-event-id → 202 → async). Maps to `bee wire-webhook`.
tools.when_to_use: When you need to receive a Stripe/Shopify/Svix webhook without double-processing under provider retries.

tools.name: pick_tool
tools.description: The decision oracle: recommends a tool WITH the named falls-short + the reversibility cost. Maps to `bee pick-tool`.
tools.when_to_use: When you must choose between BullMQ / Inngest / Temporal / QStash / SQS for a given workload profile.

tools.name: check_versions
tools.description: Version-drift oracle: flag stale pins + the BullMQ stall-loop floor (<5.78.1). Maps to `bee check`.
tools.when_to_use: When you want to know whether a jobs layer's pins are current and above the known-bug floor.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Print a pitfall/scenario/opinion by ID with detection + fix + source. Maps to `bee explain`.
tools.when_to_use: When you have a P-/S-/O- ID and want its canonical detection + remediation.

tools.name: search_brain
tools.description: BM25 ranked search over brain/ — the Memory layer over MCP. Maps to `bee brain`.
tools.when_to_use: When you need bee's stance on a jobs question (e.g. dedup-TTL sizing, jitter by error type, durable-exec vs a plain queue).

install_instructions:
1. Build the package: pnpm install && pnpm build
2. Add this plugin to Claude Code: Settings -> Plugins -> Add local plugin -> select this directory (or `claude plugin install bee`).
3. The bee CLI, the bee MCP tools (9), the 5 skills, the pin-exact + exactly-once grep-gate hooks (the dogfood: bee's harness obeys bee's law), and the 2 sub-agent personas (idempotency-auditor + durable-exec-reviewer) are now available.
